question: Should this Feishu media fallback PR require real Feishu Open Platform proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the mocked-client seam proof for this narrow helper-reuse fix?
rationale: Repository policy requires real behavior proof for external channel/API delivery changes, but the code shape reuses an already-shipped fallback helper and live Feishu tenant access may be difficult for contributors.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real Feishu setup provides redacted logs, terminal output, copied live output, or a short recording showing image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly waive the live-proof gap because the patch reuses the existing text/card fallback contract and has focused regression tests, while owning the remaining live transport uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real Feishu setup provides redacted logs, terminal output, copied live output, or a short recording showing image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal.
